successors.name: Eastern Roman Empire
successors.text: the Thracian plain between 'Philippi (or Philippopolis)' (Plovdiv) and 'Arcadiopolis' (Luleburgaz), where Strabo 'at the command of his people in Thrace' operated and died 'near Philippi in Thrace'…

ledger.x: 471: Strabo's Goths attack Philippopolis and take Arcadiopolis.
473: peace with Leo; the Goths become Roman federates.
January 474 onward: Strabo rebels against Zeno.
481: Strabo dies and the Thracian Goths' war ends.

wars.name: Revolt of Theodoric Strabo
wars.outcome: Peace in 473: the Goths' independence is recognised, the Byzantines pay an annual tribute of 2000 pounds of gold and Strabo is to obtain the rank of magister militum; no land is named.

wars.name: Strabo's wars against Zeno
wars.outcome: Strabo rebels against Zeno in 474, backs Basiliscus in 475, is attacked by Theoderic the Amal on Zeno's order in 476/477-478, and dies in 481 after defeating the Bulgars; no treaty ends the war.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary; the Goths are placed 'in Thrace' and by three place names (Philippopolis, Arcadiopolis, Stabulum Diomedis near Philippi).
